scope: Read completed report, per-query CSV and fixed cases; checked their consistency and interpretation. Did not repeat production scoring or bootstrap.
approved_claims: With frozen I-JEPA descriptors, matching geometry, candidate set and cosine readout, increasing averaging from2x2(H) to4x4(BR) at identical phase/density/support is sufficient to worsen localization on this known population.
Coarse sampling and bilinear reconstruction of the same H field also worsen error; this contrast does not split sampling from reconstruction.
4x4 averaging conditionally improves coarse-grid results relative to2x2(DR), so smoothness has an interaction with sampling rather than a universally harmful effect.

These operator effects and common-interior results localize a failure of this concrete compressed-field plus fixed-correspondence pipeline; they do not identify a defective neural layer or prove that pooled information cannot support another readout.
required_precision: Say border replication/clamping cannot be the sole explanation, rather than eliminating all boundary or encoder-context effects. The863-query interior subset changes the population and is not an independent confirmation.
Do not call H and R equivalent overall: all-population H-minus-R dx CI crosses zero, but four-coordinate motion MSE increases0.1770065037317198px2 with95CI[0.05459184207381734,0.3020185714424571].
DBR better than DR is compatible with an anti-aliasing explanation, but this study has not separately established aliasing as the mechanism.
The4x4-versus2x2 comparison holds grid geometry fixed but still changes feature statistics and cosine cost ordering; do not generalize its effect to all smoothers or all learned readers.
1024 and863 are object queries, not independent bootstrap units; the fixed bootstrap uses256 whole worlds.
No encoder network, KRR reader or original memory writer was trained or changed; no original memory gate was repaired.

suggested_next_falsifiable_step.name: Equivariant descriptor-transport control before another network intervention
suggested_next_falsifiable_step.fixed: Reuse authenticated source fields and same ROI/cosine/candidate/tie rule. Choose a fixed set of grid-aligned shifts before scoring; keep all arms on a common support including every shifted query.
interventions: Exact continuous transport of each source field: define target F1(p)=F0(p-delta) and query it directly.
Native-grid sampled transport: sample that same shifted field once at each arm native centers, retain the registered precision, then reconstruct/query by its registered bilinear rule.
Compare these controlled costs and rank/margin/tie outcomes with the already archived actual-frame costs.
falsifiable_interpretation: Failure or ambiguity under exact continuous transport points to the chosen descriptor/cosine cost ambiguity without needing a second encoder pass.
Exact transport succeeds but sampled transport fails: native sampling/reconstruction can suffice even under a perfectly equivariant underlying field.

Both transport controls succeed but actual frames fail: investigate actual temporal feature inconsistency, contextual changes or rendering/feature equivariance next; the experiment alone still cannot uniquely blame the encoder.
suggested_next_falsifiable_step.boundaries: A privileged synthetic transformation of existing feature fields, not physical-scene confirmation or a deployable new reader. No new encoding, data generation, model fitting or scientific run was performed for this review.
